lead.h: Major code tools change their changelogs to "one horizontal line". Makers: users do not need to know what changed
p: From this week the changelogs of several code tools no longer list what was changed. One horizontal line is all that is left on the page. A maker's statement says users "only need to know it got better".
Someone who builds products asked in the comments: then how do I know when it got worse. An hour later the comment could not be seen.
